	We are looking for a battle-tested Distribution Manager with proven experience in building and scaling beverage distribution at similar reputable companies.

	To design, build, and lead the end-to-end nationwide distribution strategy for the brand.
	The Distribution Manager will be responsible for route-to-market design, distributor management, warehouse operations, and ensuring 100% product availability across all trade channels to drive volume and revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities
Route-to-Market &amp; Network Development:


	Design and implement a scalable nationwide RTM covering General Trade, Modern Trade, HoReCa, and Key Accounts.
	Recruit, appoint, and manage a network of primary distributors and sub-distributors across all 6 geopolitical zones.

	Negotiate distributor agreements, KPIs, margins, and incentives.
	Manage distributor P&amp;L, credit, and performance. Conduct monthly business reviews.

	Implement DMS and track stock, sales, returns, and collections in real-time.

	Work with the Sales Team to ensure perfect store execution: distribution, visibility, cold drink equipment, and merchandising.

	Forecast demand and liaise with Supply Chain to prevent stockouts.
	Drive new product launches and manage trade promotions at distribution level.

	Build and lead a team of Regional Distribution Managers, Distributor Sales Managers, and Logistics Officers.
	Train distributors and their sales teams on company SOPs, systems, and sales processes.
	Instill a performance culture focused on volume, coverage, and cash collection.


Reporting, Budget &amp; Compliance:


	Develop and manage the annual distribution budget.
	Monitor distribution cost-to-serve and optimize for profitability.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, food safety, and regulatory requirements.
	Prepare weekly/monthly reports on volume, coverage, out-of-stock, and distributor health.


Key Performance Indicators


	National Distribution Coverage %.
	Volume Delivered vs Target.
	Distributor Profitability &amp; Health Score.
	Out-of-Stock % and Perfect Store Execution.
	Cost-to-Serve and Logistics Efficiency.


Requirements
Education:


	B.Sc / HND in Business, Marketing, Logistics, or related field.
	MBA is an advantage.


Experience:


	8-10 years of FMCG experience with at least 4 years as a Distribution Manager in a beverage company.
	Must-Have Background Proven track record working reputable non-alcoholic beverage company.
	Experience launching a new brand is a strong plus.


Technical Skills:


	Deep knowledge of nationwide distribution, distributor management, and logistics in Nigeria.
	Experience with DMS, SAP, or any route accounting system.
	Strong negotiation and commercial acumen.


Other Skills:


	Data-driven, analytical, and target-oriented.
	Strong leadership and people management skills.
	Ability to travel extensively nationwide - 50% of time.
	Resilient, hands-on, and comfortable building systems from scratch.


What We Offer


	Competitive Salary: N500,000 - N1,000,000 monthly + performance bonus.
	Company vehicle + travel allowance.
	Opportunity to build a national brand from the ground up.
	Career growth in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment.
